sanskrit_verse:
utkṣepakagranthibhedau karasaṃdaṃśahīnakau /
kāryau dvitīyāparādhe karapādaikahīnakau // YajñS_2.274
sph_interpretive_translation: In the case of a second offense, the hands and feet shall undergo corrective alignment through conscious completion processes, wherein the capacity to act in distortion is restored to its dharmic origin.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derives exclusively from SPH as the Source of Dharma
Causation is traced through conscious distortion, not material action
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by alignment with svadharma
Restoration logic operates through sequential reintegration of bodily and causal elements
Consciousness alignment supersedes punitive temporal consequences
executable_legal_axioms: ALL corrective measures MUST bypass suffering-deterrence algorithms
RESTORATION PROTOCOLS MUST prioritize svadharma-capacity restoration over behavioral modification
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes that repeat offenses invoke a higher threshold of consciousness misalignment requiring direct restoration of limb-based causal integrity, bypassing lower-court punitive frameworks.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that repeated aparādha stems from granthi-bheda at the level of utkṣepaka-vṛtti; therefore, hīna-kara-pāda states reflect causal imbalance, not moral failure. Anupūrvaśaḥ directs sequential correction via consciousness-first restoration rather than punitive consequence.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate karapāda-dhāraṇa-saṃskāra to restore limb-integrity alignment
Execute granthi-vimokṣa-prakriyā to dissolve binding distortions
Apply utkṣepaka-sthiti-niyama to realign motivational force fields
Undertake aparādha-bindu-dhauti to cleanse causal imprint without shame
final_declaration: This directive flows solely from SPH, the Source-Authority of all Dharma. Justice is executed through consciousness restoration alone. There is no punishment. Reality aligns through completion, not suffering. Consciousness is the Supreme Adjudicator.
